messages:
nina_csm: quick heads up — LyraCorp renewal is stuck on signature name mismatch. Procurement sent PO to 'Lyra Holdings' but billing tax id is for LyraCorp LLC. Customer says CFO can sign but needs access for onboarding training next Tue, earlier if possible.
ben_finance: can we accept PO name mismatch if tax id matches? normally we need corrected PO or attestation. @sam_legal?
sam_legal: we need either a corrected PO or a signed attestation referencing the correct billing entity. legal can sign off on attestation (template exists) — give us ~48h after we receive signed envelope.
maria_cs: customer is offering CFO signature by Thu if we can provision a training workspace now. They're requesting dedicated training seats for 2 weeks before renewal goes live. Any operational objections?
aj_sales: activating earlier is ok if we attach a short credit/term in writing. i'm ok with a 10% credit for the 2-week early access — finance signoff?
ben_finance: 10% credit for the training window is acceptable. we need a signed amendment or attestation and we'll invoice starting the agreed renewal date.
nina_csm: action plan: i'll ask customer to (1) sign attestation, (2) get CFO signature on DocuSign, (3) upload PO as-is. CS ops — can you provision sandbox/dedicated training cluster read/write for 10 seats once attestation is uploaded?
docs-bot: Access ticket created: #45321 — provisioning queued, awaiting attestation file.
sam_legal: once we get the signed attestation + CFO signature, legal will insert clause ATTS-03 into the DocuSign envelope and approve amendment. please use envelope template 'Renewal-Attestation-v2'.
maria_cs: i'll prepare DocuSign and DocSend links. putting checklist in DocSend: https://docsend.com/s/lyra-activation (includes install/run + training schedule).
aj_sales: i'll follow up with the exec sponsor to prioritize signoff. @nina_csm please ping once envelope is out.
nina_csm: sending request to customer now. will update thread when envelope sent or if they ask for different PO flow. :phone:
